title: Teach ScanFinder a new document
description: Teach one example so a supplier's documents read correctly from then on: open Teach, pick a Copperfield invoice, choose the type, draw a box around the issuer / date / number with live read-backs, and commit. The example is selected via eval_js (the Copperfield card) so the verified box fractions always match, since the doc-picker search box only appears for queues over eight documents.

steps.narration: Teaching is how ScanFinder learns a supplier you deal with often. You point out where the key details sit on one example, and from then on it reads every document from that sender the same way — without you lifting a finger.
steps.caption: Teach one document — file every one after it
